This advancement places us at the forefront of comprehensive cancer care in the region — blending world-class technology, experienced oncology teams, and compassionate support to give every patient a stronger, fighting chance.

From accurate diagnosis to advanced therapy — we are here, every step of the way.

title: ILS Hospitals Dum Dum is proud to have the privilege of partnering with the Indian Medical Association for “World No Tobacco Day, 2024″
excerpt: ILS Hospitals Dum Dum is proud to have the privilege of partnering with the Indian Medical Associati...

breadcrumb.name: ILS Hospitals Dum Dum is proud to have the privilege of partnering with the Indian Medical Association for “World No Tobacco Day, 2024″

content:
ILS Hospitals Dum Dum is proud to have the privilege of partnering with the Indian Medical Association, Dum Dum, Bengal State for the commemoration of “WORLD NO TOBACCO DAY, 2024” at Hotel Pipal Tree, Chinar Park. Dr. Tirthankar Bagchi, COO of ILS Hospitals Dum Dum, and Mr. Debashis Dhar, Senior Group Vice President and Chief Business Development, added prestige to the event.

The event was honored by distinguished consultants from Kolkata, including Dr. Ananda Bagchi, President, IMA Dum Dum.

Dr. Mrinmoy Mitra, specialist in Pulmonology and Chest Medicine at ILS Hospitals, provided essential insights into the correlation between ‘Tobacco Usage and Lung Diseases’.

Dr. Arpan Chaudhuri, an Expert in Critical Care, ILS Hospitals addressed a crucial topic concerning the ‘Impact of Tobacco on the Health of Children’.

title: ILS Hospitals Agartala celebrate World Pilot Day on 25th April, 2024
excerpt: ILS Hospitals Agartala, in collaboration with Indigo Airlines, organized a complimentary health chec...

breadcrumb.name: ILS Hospitals Agartala celebrate World Pilot Day on 25th April, 2024

content:
ILS Hospitals Agartala, in collaboration with Indigo Airlines, organized a complimentary health check-up camp at Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport, Agartala on 25th April, from 9am to 5pm, to celebrate World Pilot Day.

During this health camp, not only the employees of Indigo Airlines but also the employees of other organizations present at the airport had the opportunity to undergo a comprehensive health screening. Our team of experienced consultants from ILS Hospitals conducted thorough examinations, including assessments of body weight, height, random blood sugar levels, BMI, and more.

We take immense pride in being a part of this noble initiative and look forward to promoting the well-being of all individuals involved.
